name: Metrocali
body: HSTS marked for preload, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, a Permissions-Policy, and a CSP. But the home page description is a single notice about a vehicle scrapping resolution, not what the system offers.
lesson: Write a fixed home description about your service. Don't let the CMS fill it from the latest post.
summary: metrocali.gov.co scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 83 images have no width or height.

fix.title: 83 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', script-src allows any host, object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:image
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: 20 HTML documents are heavier than 500 KB
fix.fix: Move inline data and SVG out of the HTML.

fix.title: 5 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
